high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a presentation at MIT's Brain + Cognitive Sciences event. The slide is titled "Towards models of generalized visual abstraction" and poses the question: "What is needed to build algorithms that emulate human production & comprehension of abstract (i.e., non-photorealistic) images?" The slide features a diagram illustrating the process of creating abstract representations of an image. It shows a bird (a blue tit) on the left side, which is then transformed into two simplified, abstract versions of the bird on the right side.
